name: Red Watch
crew: Marisol Ferreira|Tom Oduya|Grace Lindqvist|Ben Achterfeld|Priya Nandakumar|Hal Brennock
summary: The original watch, formed the year the station opened. Most of its crew live within a mile of the slipway.
body:
The original watch, formed the year the station opened. Most of its crew live within a mile of the slipway.

When the watch has the pager, its crew stay within six minutes of the station, day and night, for seven days from Monday 08:00. The other three watches back them up for anything that needs a second boat.
